strategic_playbook.posture: Front-runner. Play safe, close the door.
strategic_playbook.base_case: Model: BN alone ~19-22 seats. Newswav analyst: BN+PN 50%. Structural favourite in Malay-majority + rural seats; Johor blueprint is the template.
to_win: Lock the Malay heartland — keep semi-urban Malay (51% lean) from drifting via daily ceramah in Rembau, Kuala Pilah, Jempol, Tampin. Tok Mat, Zambry, Onn Hafiz on rotation.
Ship the manifesto before Thursday. Every day BN runs without a manifesto lets PH's '30k jobs / 20k homes / RM200 SSPN' set the substance frame. Match with concrete state-level numbers, not slogans.
Neutralise the royal-dispute drag. Onn Hafiz's Sunday rebuttal was on-message — keep him and Tok Mat in Jelebu/Jempol/Tampin all week. Do NOT let the Undang framing metastasise.
Discipline the PN pact publicly. Zahid's MB-claim is fine; Marzuki's 'Umno toppled PN' jibe is not. Every intra-pact quarrel gives PH the wasted-vote argument in mixed seats.
Keep MCA visible on the joint ticket. MCA-vacates-three-seats plus Wee's Loke attack was the right move — repeat it in Bahau and Rasah to hold the 23% Chinese vote at ~15% instead of ~5%.
failure_mode: If BN's manifesto is late, thin, or federal-flavoured, PH consolidates the 'we're the only ones with a plan for NS' frame and pulls semi-urban Malay back.
If Umno keeps needling Bersatu publicly, opposition-Malay voters who would have split to Bersatu instead consolidate to PN — a net loss in Malay-mixed seats like Klawang, Sikamat, Kota.
If the royal-dispute framing escalates and Tok Mat does not visibly defuse it, Jelebu/Jempol margins compress and 2-3 seats slip.

Complacency risk: Johor turnout was 74%; a repeat 55% Chinese turnout only holds if BN keeps DAP-only-cares-about-DAP framing alive. If Chinese turnout climbs to 65% because of Loke's 'traitors and rebels' provocation, DAP holds its firewall and pact ceiling drops.

strategic_playbook.posture: Trailing challenger. Substance-and-turnout play, not conversion.
strategic_playbook.base_case: Model: PH ~10-13 seats. Newswav analyst: PH 35%. Structural underdog on Malay math; must defend the 2023 firewall and steal 2-3 semi-urban seats.
to_win: Own the substance week. Manifesto launch is Day 4 — the '30k jobs / 20k homes / MVV 2.0 / NS Semiconductor Valley / RM200 SSPN' package is real. Repeat it every day, in every ceramah, in Malay-language first. Do not let it become an 'urban Chinese wishlist'.

Fix the Anwar-absence problem now. Either bring him to NS for one high-visibility rally by Day 7, or reframe Aminuddin as 'the local MB who governs NS' and lean into Aminuddin's on-foot ground game (Linggi Sunday walkabout is the model).

Contain the Chean Chung 'reformasi is dead' story internally. Public silence gives the framing oxygen. A DAP-internal reply — not a Loke reply — that acknowledges the frustration but recommits to the platform, within 48 hours.

Drive Chinese turnout above 65%. Johor's 55% Chinese turnout was the pact's structural gift. Nicole Tan (Bukit Kepayang) + Loke (Chennah) + Rasah + Lobak need coordinated turnout ops targeted at soft DAP voters, not new converts. Cost-of-living framing to hold the SME segment (54% lean).
Convert middle-income households (51% lean, softest segment). Target subsidy-targeting messaging at Seremban/Nilai/Port Dickson. This is where the 2-3 gain seats live.
Isolate Bersatu as spoiler in Klawang, Sikamat, Kota. Every Bersatu vote in a 3-way is a de-facto BN vote — Bakri Sawir's 6.3% 2023 margin is the canary. Make this argument every day.
failure_mode: If PH lets Anwar's non-attendance dominate two more news cycles, the 'PM abandoned NS' frame locks in and semi-urban Malay soft-PH voters (currently 42%) collapse to ~35%.
If Chinese turnout comes in at 55% or below (Johor-parity), DAP's firewall cracks in Rasah/Lobak/Mambau and the seat floor drops from ~13 to ~9.
If the Chean Chung story metastasises into a broader 'DAP youth wing revolt' narrative, urban Chinese enthusiasm drops another 5-8 points on turnout.
If PH answers the '2018 empty promises' BN attack defensively instead of with third-party validation (industry endorsements, economist quotes on MVV 2.0), the manifesto shine fades by Day 8.
If PH cannot make the Bersatu-as-spoiler case stick in 3-way Malay-mixed seats, PN plus Bersatu combined take Klawang and one of Sikamat/Kota — floor drops to ~8.

strategic_playbook.posture: Junior pact partner. Consolidate PAS core, don't get squeezed out.
strategic_playbook.base_case: Model: ~2-4 seats via pact allocation. Rural PAS-branch seats and one or two Malay-heartland spillovers.
to_win: Turn out the PAS-branch machine in Jelebu/Jempol/Tampin. Not conversion — turnout. The PAS core is small in NS but disciplined; every 1,000 marginal PAS votes in a rural 3-way is decisive.
Take Zahid's MB claim quietly. Public objection kills the pact's Malay-unity story that carries PN's 4-seat ceiling. Bank the pact seats, litigate leadership after the vote.

Ride the Instagram/TikTok youth-Malay signal. Youth 18-25 shifted PN 2022 → BN 2026 on TikTok, but Instagram data shows Malay-heartland comments still split — PN's 'Gelombang Biru' reels are landing. Push more of this, less of the federal-grievance content.
Keep Bersatu at arm's length. Public distance from Bersatu preserves the pact frame; Muhyiddin's isolation is a feature, not a bug.
failure_mode: If PN publicly disputes Zahid's MB claim, the pact fractures visibly and PH regains the wasted-vote counter in Malay-mixed seats. Pact ceiling drops from 22-25 to 18-20.
If PN campaigns on federal grievances (petrol, RON95 targeting, Anwar-personal) instead of state issues, BN quietly runs the show and PN takes 1 seat instead of 3.
If PN allows Bersatu to poach Malay-opposition votes unchallenged in Sikamat/Kota, the pact loses 1-2 seats that were structurally winnable.

strategic_playbook.posture: Isolated third force. Survival play, not victory.
strategic_playbook.base_case: Model: 0-1 seats. Tun Faisal (Sikamat) is the only credible path; everywhere else Bersatu is a spoiler.
to_win: Concentrate everything on Sikamat + one other winnable urban-Malay mixed seat. Do not campaign the state — campaign 2 seats.
Own the 'Bersatu is not PN' distinction. Umno's 'we toppled PN once' jibe frames Bersatu as PN's baggage. Reject that publicly and campaign as a clean-slate Malay reformist alternative to both blocs.
Convert soft-PN youth Malay voters in Sikamat via TikTok. Tun Faisal is a known face; use it.
Accept the spoiler role in Malay-mixed 3-ways as a structural gift you cannot avoid — but do not amplify it. Any seat where Bersatu takes >5% helps BN, not you.
failure_mode: If Bersatu splits the anti-BN Malay vote in Klawang, Kota, Sikamat without winning any of them, party enters 2027 with zero NS seats and Muhyiddin's leadership question opens.
If the 'wasted vote' PH counter lands, Bersatu voter share compresses from 8-12% to under 5% state-wide and the party ceases to be a factor.
If Marzuki-style Umno attacks continue without a strong Bersatu counter, the party becomes 'the party that helped BN win NS' — a brand problem heading into GE16.

coordinated_flags.note: **FINAL FLAG — MODEL LESSON.** Post-election review: the UMNO+PAS vote consolidation flagged repeatedly in narratives_up (Hadi's PAS-vote-BN directive, PN mega-ceramah, Sanusi Malay-vote framing) proved decisive but the model's priors under-weighted the effect by 6pp of seat share. In future NS/Malaysian rural elections, informal Malay-party cooperation should be modelled at higher confidence when both Bersatu-PN internal splits AND explicit vote-transfer statements from party leaders coincide. No fabricated content flagged post-poll. AFP-flagged fakes (Zahid quit, EC early-vote count) did not have detectable material impact on turnout or result.

Straits Times noted 6 of 10 remaining seats are Malay-majority and would help BN-PN 'get close to two-thirds'. **MACC opens 4 cash-distribution investigations** (2 candidates, 2 voters) in parallel to police's 3 IPs + 72yr-old Tampin TikTok RM300 police report. Enforcement noise consistent with prior 4-day pattern — no criminal escalation triggered before silence.

**AFP Fact Check confirmed TWO fabricated news graphics** circulating during silence period: (a) fake 'DPM Zahid quits Unity Govt' quote — his office denied to AFP on 29 Jul as 'fake'; (b) fake EC infographic purporting early-vote counts — EC officially denied on FB 29 Jul, stating early-vote counting only begins 5pm 1 Aug after voting completes. Closing coordinated disinformation event before silence, targeting Malay-language WhatsApp/Telegram/TikTok.

**Ilham Centre projection** (BN-PN 22 / PH 9 / TCTC 5) released on final campaigning day. Timing gives BN-PN 24h+ of unopposed narrative amplification into silence period. Framing explicitly cites 'Malay unity, political stability, prevent PH win' as decisive with Malay fence-sitters. Not disinformation, but signals coordinated closing narrative. Ong Kian Ming's parallel reaffirmation (23-25 range) landed same-day.

changelog.summary: **⭐ POST-ELECTION ACCURACY REVIEW ⭐** OFFICIAL EC RESULTS: **BN 18, PN 7, PH 11**. BN+PN combined **25 seats** = two-thirds majority. Turnout **72.64%** (646,084 voters — final surge from 65.38% at 4pm). **MODEL SCORECARD: (a) Government direction — CORRECT (BN+PN forms govt, model gave 73% probability). (b) Per-seat accuracy — 30/36 correct (83.3%). (c) Zero within-coalition confusion — all misses were direction. (d) Coalition mean seats: model BN+PN 18.5 vs actual 25 (-6.5 underestimate); model PH 17.5 vs actual 11 (+6.5 overestimate). BIGGEST HITS: Predicted BN+PN government from Day 1 despite Ilham/Ong hedging. Called Aminuddin losing Linggi correctly. Flagged UMNO+PAS Malay consolidation as biggest risk repeatedly. BIGGEST MISSES: 6 PH-called seats flipped — N01 Chennah (Loke lost by 688 votes), N13 Sikamat, N14 Ampangan, N18 Pilah, N25 Paroi, N36 Repah. **Root cause: UMNO+PAS informal cooperation delivered 6pp stronger Malay-vote consolidation than priors captured.** Amanah wiped out (0/7). Bersatu shut out (0/24 own-logo). DAP retained as PH's core (8/11 PH seats). Both dashboard crons will be deleted immediately after this notification. Dashboard now retired.

**POLLING DAY EVENING. Polls closed 6pm. Counting underway.** Model held at BN+PN 73%. **Turnout trajectory:** 8.29% (9am) → 18.22% (10am) → 28.11% (11am) → 37.29% (12pm) → 59.03% (3pm) → **65.38% (4pm)**. Only 3.49pp above 2023 at same 4pm mark. Below EC target 72-75% and IDERC 68-70% band. Final rate likely ~67-70%. **Highest DUNs**: Kota 72.1%, Seri Menanti 70.9%, Labu 70.9% (all Malay-majority, expected BN). **Lowest**: Bahau, Lukut, Lobak stuck at 59% (all non-Malay-majority, PH incumbent). **The Edge unofficial tally at 5pm: BN leading in 9 seats — Pertang, Juasseh, Pilah, Johol, Labu, Rantau, Gemas, Gemencheh, Repah.** All Malay-majority. No PH or PN leads reported yet. **DAP unofficial leads (small samples via DAP live blog)**: Mambau 64% (Lee Kai Yet), Bahau 78% (Teo Kok Seong), Bukit Kepayang 63% (Nicole Tan). **Ong Kian Ming REVISED DOWN** to BN-PN 17 / PH 9 (from yesterday's 23-25) — still a coalition win but tighter than Ilham's 22 projection. Prof Wong Chin Huat similarly forecasts BN-PN win on UMNO+PAS consolidation. **Postal vote counting began 5pm — 12,000 ballots at 8 tallying centres.** Aminuddin + Tok Mat completed voting. No royal-dispute update, no scandal, no incident. Full results expected before midnight per EC. Model held: direction confirmed by early leads.

**POLLING DAY MORNING. Polls open 8am-6pm at 401 centres.** Model held at BN+PN 73%. **Silence-period developments overnight:** (a) **AFP Fact Check confirmed TWO fabricated news graphics** circulating — fake Zahid 'quits Unity Govt' quote (his office denied) + fake EC early-vote count infographic (EC denied 29 Jul on FB). Closing coordinated disinformation event. (b) **MACC opens 4 cash-distribution probes** — 2 involving candidates, 2 voters. Parallel to police's 3 IPs + 72yr-old Tampin TikTok RM300 report. (c) Weather: MetMalaysia clear skies morning across all 7 districts; thunderstorms afternoon in all districts except PD; 23-33°C. EC target 72-75%; independent projections 68-75%. **Anwar final push urged voters to give PH mandate for stability & growth. Zahid: 'high turnout could be game changer for BN'. PH's Amirudin publicly targeted minimum 19 seats.** 867,151 voters, 103 candidates, 36 seats, 401 centres. Early voting 91.06%. Full results expected before midnight per EC; preliminary ~10pm. **26h projections from yesterday (Ilham 22 BN-PN / 9 PH / 5 TCTC; Ong 23-25 BN-PN; IDERC 'too close to call' 68-70% turnout) remain in effect — no new formal opinion poll overnight.**

**31 Jul evening. Final campaigning day (silence 11.59pm tonight).** Model held at BN+PN 73%. **Two projection releases today:** (a) Ilham Centre: BN-PN 22 / PH 9 / TCTC 5 (Chennah, Linggi, Nilai, Repah, Temiang all with BN) — 'Malay unity, political stability, prevent PH win' named as decisive themes with Malay fence-sitters. (b) IDERC: too close to call, 68-70% turnout, 12-18% undecided, 8 marginals decide. Ong Kian Ming publicly reaffirmed BN-PN 23-25 projection; said Loke at risk in Chennah, Aminuddin at risk in Linggi. Both aligned qualitatively with 73% call. Anwar today: 'forgive and reunite' FB video + Port Dickson Sahabat Usahawan MADANI carnival + 'we've waited long enough' Tabung Haji framing at Kuala Pilah. BN closing night: Wee Ka Siong + Chong Sin Woon at Bukit Pelanduk / Chuah. PN closing 'Biru-kan Port Dickson' held 30 Jul at Batu 8 Teluk Kemang — Tuan Ibrahim demanded TH reform. PH hybrid strategy: house-to-house + aggressive TikTok. Police: 87 reports / 23 IPs / 761 permits approved. Fahmi targets 21-22 PH seats. Ilham/IDERC are pre-election projections without public methodology; treated as confirmatory, not directional.

**31 Jul morning brief. Final campaigning day.** Model held at BN+PN 73% (no new formal poll, no defection, no leader change, no royal-dispute update). Overnight: Anwar's Munajat Perdana sequence completed at Linggi (7.27pm) + Kuala Pilah Dataran Melang (9.15pm) with named sheikhs; PH's most explicit anti-racial-incitement closing pitch. Anwar pledged pondok-schools upgrade allocation after polls (Linggi). PN Ceramah Mega Biru-kan Port Dickson tonight at Batu 8 Teluk Kemang — closing coordinated BN-PN set-piece. Anwar's Tabung Haji framing amplified internationally (SCMP). 3 more vote-buying reports lodged Wed; 689 of 715 permits approved. Zaid Ibrahim skeptical of PH raising Felda + TH pre-poll. Utusan: 'pact must be proven at ballot'. Campaigning silence at 11.59pm tonight. Merdeka/INVOKE/Ilham silent 8+ days. 40 hours to polling.

**30 Jul evening update.** Model held at BN+PN 73%. Two pact-discipline milestones today: (1) **Hadi Awang formally directed PAS members to vote BN candidates in non-PN seats** — first public party-leader directive locking in reciprocity mechanic (Ceramah Mega Biru-kan Seremban context). (2) **Hamzah Zainudin publicly confirmed PN has left NS MB pick to BN** — pact operational discipline explicit, denies rift with BN. Anwar apologised to Indian community 29 Jul at Klana Resort for 'illegal temple' remark — ST frames as 'last-ditch' attempt. Anwar Munajat Perdana tonight at Dataran Melang, Kuala Pilah. Straits Times consensus solidifies: 'most punters predicting third successive state polls loss for Anwar's PH'. Bernama: 4,481 ceramah held across campaign. 318 Johor police mobilised to assist. Model unchanged (no new poll, no defection, no leader change, no royal-dispute update). Campaigning closes tomorrow 11.59pm.

**30 Jul morning brief.** Model held at BN+PN 73% (no new poll, no defection, no leader change). Overnight material: **UMNO's Jempol MP Shamsulkahar Deli also under police probe** (S.505b + S.4A(1) EOA + S.233 CMA) over remarks allegedly linking DAP to Sultan Selangor insult — brings BN into the enforcement spotlight and makes the police-probe narrative symmetric across BN and PN. Zahid publicly backed the vote-buying probe. PH Betaria Grand Finale done (Loke: 'momentum strongest', 75-80% turnout target). Anwar committed to 'personally oversee' Indian community affairs at Klana Resort. Anwar's Kuala Pilah Berselawat tonight (Dataran Melang) with named sheikhs. PH's 24-hour TikTok livestream launches this evening. PN's Biru-kan Seremban Ceramah Mega done 29 Jul night with Hadi/Hamzah/Mukhriz/Sanusi/Khaled/Maslan/Alwi/Dominic Lau. EC debunked viral 'PN leading early votes' infographic — coordinated disinformation now flagged. 48 hours to polling.

**29 Jul evening update.** Model held at BN+PN 73% (no new poll, no defection, no discrete shock). Major event of the day: **Court of Appeal granted the interim stay on the DKU committal proceedings** — 3R royal-dispute vector formally defused for the campaign runway. Case management tomorrow. Anwar's packed schedule: Chennah tea (with Loke), Paroi Temu Anwar, Klana Resort Indian community dinner, Betaria + Desa Cempaka Grand Finale rallies. PH announced a 24-hour non-stop TikTok livestream starting tomorrow evening — first candidate-plus-influencer livestream of this scale in Malaysia. Sanusi LOD campaign hit first recipient (PKR Hulu Selangor Sathia Prakash) with 56k FB likes. Total election-related police reports climbed to 62, IPs 19 (up from 53/16). New: attempted vote-buying via WhatsApp opened as separate S.11 EOA IP. Muhyiddin challenged UMNO to withdraw Selangor support. 68 hours to polling.

**29 Jul morning brief.** Model held at BN+PN 73% (no new poll, no defection, no discrete shock overnight). Confirmatory developments: (1) Early voting closed 91.06% (target 90%) — uniformed lean historically favours BN. (2) Sanusi shifted from defence to counter-attack: filed LOD against PKR Selangor election director Sathia Prakash for defamation, invoked Oliver Stanley (1946), Lord Killearn (1949), Lord Ogmore (1957) as historical basis for 'Tanah Melayu' phrasing. Second police report also confirmed — IP still open under S.505B + S.233 CMA + S.4A(1) EOA. (3) Court of Appeal hears DKU interim stay TODAY.
